limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The theorem is specific to the q-decimal finite-precision RoPE and overflow semantics of Qiao et al.; it does not cover infinite or input-growing precision, stochastic decoding, external memory or tools, or nonperiodic realized positional mechanisms. The explicit state bound is crude. The regular-language context for component-periodic RoPE is prior work and is not claimed as novel. The motivating preprint is extremely recent, so later revisions or near-simultaneous work remain an originality risk. No independent validation is asserted.
provenance: Scientific sources and proof evidence are listed in RESULT.md and REVIEW.md.
